benches.name: lockstep_enreg_xlk
benches.cmd: W=$(mktemp -d /tmp/smtb.XXXXXX); python3 tools/dshbm_sm_pq_seq.py run --seq stress --nc 8 --active 8 --rmax 4096 --req-credit --smh --cg --define OT_SMH_CG_ENREG --define OT_SMH_XLK --define OT_FP_DATA_NORST --define OT_SMH_DRST0 --define OT_SMH_RSTRELAY --define OT_SMH_RSTPIN --define OT_SMH_HIER --define OT_SMH_PTW_OHDLY --define OT_SMH_PINREG --define OT_SMH_XREL --define OT_SMH_PRODUCTION_SHAPE --cg-gap 300 --build-jobs 8 --workdir $W --out {RUN}/b_lockstep_enreg_xlk.json > {RUN}/b_lockstep_enreg_xlk.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {RUN}/b_lockstep_enreg_xlk.log | tail -5; grep -h CG_LOCKSTEP $W/*/runtime.log; test $rc -eq 0 && grep -q 'CG_LOCKSTEP mismatches 0 ' $W/*/runtime.log && echo SMT_LOCKSTEP_PASS
